claims: Blackstone Inc. is the world's largest alternative asset manager.
Blackstone Inc. has over $1 trillion in assets under management.
Blackstone Inc. focuses on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, and life sciences.
Blackstone Inc. was founded by Stephen A. Schwarzman and Peter G. Peterson.
Stephen A. Schwarzman is Chairman and CEO of Blackstone Inc.
Blackstone Inc. is based in New York.
Blackstone Inc. is listed on the NYSE with ticker BX.
Jon Gray is President and COO of Blackstone Inc.
Blackstone Real Estate Income Trust (BREIT) is a core product or platform of Blackstone Inc.
Blackstone Private Credit Fund (BCRED) is a core product or platform of Blackstone Inc.
Blackstone Inc. has various specialized funds in infrastructure and life sciences.
As of late 2025/early 2026, Blackstone Inc. holds over $1 trillion in AUM.
Blackstone Inc. is listed on the S&P 500.
Blackstone Inc. is distinct from Blackstone Products.
Blackstone Products manufactures outdoor gas griddles
